purpose: Define the official-record layer for registered and unregistered property information without conflating records with legal conclusions.

record_systems.purpose: Registration/search of deeds affecting unregistered land and other instruments
Public property/map and registration service access

record_to_fact_rules: A record can establish only facts supported by its contents and applicable legal framework.
A title plan is not automatically a complete physical-boundary determination.
A Registry of Deeds search does not by itself establish the full legal effect of the underlying deed.
A retrieved document must be matched to the correct property before property-specific facts are stated.
Historical records must retain their date and applicable legal context.
guardrails: No ownership conclusion without verified property-specific evidence.
No inference that public availability removes privacy considerations.
Record evidence and legal interpretation remain separate layers.
